meta.title: Las Vegas MICHELIN Guide 2026 Southwest — Complete 24-Restaurant Directory
meta.pricing_rule: Only prices printed on official first-party restaurant menus, official resort menu PDFs, or the restaurant's official reservation platform (OpenTable/Resy) are reported (11/24 total: 9 exact + 2 explicitly labelled dish-level estimates; Michael Mina flagged Temporarily Closed and excluded from active budgets). All 13 venues whose official menus omit dollar amounts are left strictly blank ('').

clusters.name: Downtown Arts District — Casino Center & S Main St

starred.name: Joël Robuchon
starred.address: 3799 S Las Vegas Blvd, Las Vegas, NV 89109
starred.exceptions: Formal dress code (jackets recommended for gentlemen; no shorts/athletic wear/open-toed shoes for men). GM Sean Christopher won the 2026 MICHELIN Service Award.
starred.price_detail: Official MGM Grand menu pages (Menu Degustation & Le Menu) omit dollar prices. Left blank per strict evidence rule; call 702.891.7925.
starred.nearest_public_transit: MGM Grand Monorail Station (in building) & RTC Deuce
starred.est_transit_from_center_strip: ~10–18 min est. via Las Vegas Monorail
starred.social_provenance: Account opened: bio links mgmgrand.com/en/restaurants/joel-robuchon-french-restaurant.html (this site's official link).
starred.social_caveat: Dormant: newest post 2020-08-07, and the bio still says 'Michelin 3-Star' — the pre-2010 status. The 2026 Guide gives TWO stars (F-54). Do not quote an account bio as a current award.

starred.name: Restaurant Guy Savoy
starred.address: 3570 S Las Vegas Blvd, Las Vegas, NV 89109
starred.exceptions: Upscale attire required. Only 5-star Center-Strip resort with an in-building MICHELIN-Starred restaurant.
starred.price_detail: ESTIMATE ONLY from official Caesars main menu (effective Nov 5, 2026): starters $100–$120 (Artichoke & Black Truffle Soup $110) + mains $160–$290 per person before dessert/tax/tip. Krug Chef's Table & Prestige Tasting Menu prices are unpublished online.
starred.nearest_public_transit: In-building at Caesars Palace; RTC Deuce at Caesars gate + Flamingo/Caesars Monorail
starred.est_transit_from_center_strip: 0 min from Caesars Palace; 5–12 min walk from Center Strip
starred.social_provenance: Account opened: bio 'Guy Savoy's restaurant at @caesarspalace in Las Vegas', links guysavoylasvegas.com.
